summary: Short signed no-stopping kerb with apartments 9 m and a house 11 m away.

best_section.where: north kerb of Sir Fred Schonell Drive beside the Sir Fred apartments, east of the junction

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block at 9 m; detached house at 11 m; homes all along this side.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a through road; cars sit at the kerb in Esri but signs forbid stopping.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with a junction and turn lanes at the east end.
drivers.convention: No stopping any time and peak-hour no stopping signs sit on the kerb line.

flags: No stopping any time signs on the kerb
sun_shade: Tall building and trees shade the kerb from the north in the morning and afternoon.
